rationale: A CRM for a rental jewellery business needs to feel premium, trustworthy, and distinctly tied to luxury, yet remain highly functional for daily management. Using a warm bone-white base with deep emerald green and soft gold accents creates a high-end 'Indian Bridal/Jewellery' aesthetic. We avoid standard 'SaaS Blue' to maintain the brand's premium identity.

components.cards: Flat surface (#FFFFFF) with 1px border (#EAE5D9) and very soft shadow (shadow-sm). No heavy drop shadows. Hover states should slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and enhance shadow.
components.tables: Minimalist premium tables. Use only horizontal bottom borders for rows (border-b border-[#EAE5D9]). Headers should be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs, text-[#737373]. Use sticky headers for vertical scrolling. Important columns like 'Bill No' should be boulder. Row hover should be bg-[#FDFBF7].
components.buttons: Primary buttons use Deep Emerald (#0A3626) with white text. Secondary buttons are transparent with 1px border (#EAE5D9) and charcoal text. Hover effects should darken the background or border slightly. Never use default blue.
components.badges: Status badges (Booked, Delivered, Returned, Overdue) must use soft background tints with high-contrast text, softly rounded (rounded-full) and bold text-xs. e.g. Overdue uses danger_bg and danger_text.
components.inputs: Forms should use transparent backgrounds or solid white with a 1px border (#EAE5D9). Focus states must ring with Deep Emerald (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A3626]/20 focus:border-[#0A3626]).

motion_and_interaction.loading_state: Use subtle pulsing skeletons (animate-pulse) with #EAE5D9 color, avoid standard gray skeletons.

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, table rows, edit/delete actions, pagination) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='create-booking-button').

domain_specific_rules.currency: Always format currency as INR (₹). E.g. ₹ 15,000
domain_specific_rules.date_format: Use clear date formats (e.g., 12 Oct 2026) for Booking, Delivery, and Return dates.
domain_specific_rules.data_density: Table contains many columns (Bill No, Product Code, Dates, Amounts, Customer Info). Implement a sticky first column (Bill No) and horizontal scrolling. Provide an 'expand' or 'view details' action for full record inspection.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use lucide-react for icons. Apply the specific typography and spacing rules. Use Shadcn UI for the data table and form components, but strip away the default Vercel-like borders/shadows and apply our 'border-[#EAE5D9]' and flat surface rules. Ensure currency is formatted in INR (₹) explicitly.
